title.narrative: Infrastructure Development Investment Program for Tourism - Tranche 2

description.narrative:
As part of the Investment Program, this Project aims to complete subprojects under four or five different components of the Investment Program in the States of Uttarakand and Tamil Nadu.
A. Component 1: Urban Infrastructure and Service Improvement B. Component 2: Connectivity Improvement C. Component 3: Quality Enhancement of Natural and Cultural Attractions D. Component 4: Community-based Activities E. Component 5: Capacity Development, Community Participation and Project Management

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Enhanced tourism environment in Tamil Nadu and Uttarakhand.

1,000 tourist/ month on average achieved at each of the new adventure/sports centers as well as the ecotourism-center at Kotdwar constructed under the Project Progress/Status: Eco tourism facility constructed at Kotdwar. The tourist inflow would be assessed at the time of preparation of the project completion report. Data Source: State Tourism Reports and Statistics Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

30% increased occupancy in the refurbished accommodation facilities and shelters at the tourist clusters Progress/Status: Construction works have been completed in accommodation facilities. Increase in occupancy percentage would be assessed during the preparation of project completion report. Data Source: State Tourism Reports and Statistics Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

At least 270 persons, including from female-headed, poor and vulnerable households, receive skilled employment (target: M-190/F-80) Progress/Status: Adequate training programs to promote skilled employment particularly focused for female - headed, poor and vulnerable households for livelihood programs have been underatken by the executing agencies. The exact employment details would be assessed at the time pf preparation of Project Completion Report. Data Source: State Tourism Reports and Statistics Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: 1,000 tourists/month on average utilizing the facilities of each of the new information centers in Tamil Nadu Progress/Status: Number of tourists arrival would be assessed at the time of preparation of the project completion report. Data Source: Tourist statistical surveys and records for both states Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: 9 selected adventure centers/sports facilities refurbished/ constructed and equipped with basic sports equipment in Uttarakhand Progress/Status: Adventure centers refurbished/ constructed and equipped with adventure tourism facilities. Data Source: Independent social, environmental and market surveys for both states Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Basic amenities provided, including safe drinking water and adequate toilets (M/F) in Uttarakhand Progress/Status: Completed basic tourist facilities and amenities in tourist clusters in Uttarakhand Data Source: Independent social, environmental and market surveys for both states Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: Basic tourist facilities and amenities improved at about 9 tourist clusters including safe drinking water and adequate toilets (M/F) in Tamil Nadu Progress/Status: Completed basic tourist facilities and amenities in 9 tourist clusters of Tamil Nadu Data Source: Independent social, environmental and market surveys for both states Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 1. Improved basic urban infrastructure and services at tourist destinations and attractions Indicator: State of the art ecotourism-resort facility constructed at the North Corbett entry point at Kotdwar in Uttarakhand Progress/Status: Completed ecotourism-resort facility constructed at the North Corbett entry point at Kotdwar in Uttarakhand Data Source: Independent social, environmental and market surveys for both states Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Improved connectivity Indicator: 2km of elevated walk-way at Assan Barrage constructed in Uttarakhand Progress/Status: Subproject related to elevated walk way at Assan Barrage not undertaken in Uttarakhand Data Source: Reports from state departments of tourism and line agencies Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 2.
